trello.name: Fix Android 14 photo upload crash
trello.desc: Marcus to fix the photo upload crash on Android 14 (NullPointerException in the media picker callback when the user backgrounds the app mid-upload). Deadline: Fixed and verified by Wednesday. Sam to confirm the fix on the Android 14 test devices once Marcus lands it and add it to the regression run.

trello.name: Build sync API for offline notes list
trello.desc: Elena to build the backend sync API for the notes list offline mode. Requirements: Client sends its last-synced timestamp and gets a delta of created, updated, and deleted notes. Conflict resolution is last-write-wins for now. Deadline: Must be in review before Elena is out on the 17th.

trello.name: Implement client-side offline mode for notes list
trello.desc: Marcus to implement the client side for offline mode. Requirements: Local cache in Room, queue writes while offline, replay them when connectivity comes back. Acceptance criteria: you can open the app in airplane mode, see your notes, edit them, and everything reconciles when you're back online with no data loss. Marcus to write this acceptance criteria into the ticket.

trello.name: Migrate CI pipelines to GitHub Actions
trello.desc: Sam to migrate pipelines from Jenkins to GitHub Actions. Requirements: Finish the test and release pipelines, keep the nightly build schedule, and run both systems in parallel for a week before turning Jenkins off. Keep Jenkins alive until the parallel week is clean.

trello.name: Add per-user rate limiting to search endpoint
trello.desc: Elena to add per-user rate limiting to the search endpoint following the recent incident. Requirements: 100 requests per minute per user, return HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header beyond that. Also add a metrics counter to see who's hitting the limit.

trello.name: Update privacy policy screen for GDPR compliance
trello.desc: Marcus to update the privacy policy screen to meet GDPR requirements for the EU launch. Requirements: Get new copy from legal, rebuild the screen so consent is opt-in with separate toggles for analytics and marketing, nothing pre-checked. Deadline: August 20 release (launch blocker).

trello.name: Write automated regression tests for payments flow
trello.desc: Sam to write regression tests for the payments flow. Requirements: Cover purchase, restore, cancellation, and the receipt validation path. Goal: Have them running in CI as part of the new GitHub Actions pipeline.
